name: aviation-weather
examples_zh: 查询KJFK和KLAX的METAR/TAF，整理一份飞行前天气简报
获取KSFO附近的PIREP，并说明是否有低云、结冰或颠簸报告
根据KSEA最新TAF，概括未来6小时起降天气风险和备降关注点
examples_en: Fetch the METAR and TAF for KJFK and KLAX and summarize a preflight weather briefing
Retrieve PIREPs near KSFO and note any reports of low ceilings, icing, or turbulence
Use the latest KSEA TAF to summarize takeoff/landing weather risks and alternate-planning concerns for the next 6 hours
description_zh: 获取 METAR/TAF 航空气象数据，飞行前天气简报，无需 API Key
description_en: Fetch METAR, TAF and PIREP aviation weather from aviationweather.gov, no API key needed
